title: Enakhra's Lament
start: Talk to Lazim, found in the desert south of the Bandit Camp.

items.t: Two 5kg granite blocks (can be obtained during the quest, with level 45 Mining)

A total of 52kg of sandstone (any combination will work as long as the number adds up to exactly 32kg and 20kg in separate sets; sandstone can be cut into smaller pieces if required. It's recommended to get 10 blocks of 5kg and one block of 2kg )
One of the following (burnt versions do not work):
Any kind of pie (partial pies and mince pie will not work)
Any kind of cake (partial cakes, RS Anniversary cake, mint cake, and cheesecakes will not work)
Any kind of pizza (partial pizza do not work)
A wand or staff with air and fire runes to cast an air and fire spell (standard spellbook required)
A white candle (a black candle or a red candle will not work)
Soft clay (bring two if you want a camel mask)
1 coal (can be retrieved from the metal bank during the quest)

recommended.t: Waterskins, or an enchanted water tiara (not needed if you have completed Crocodile Tears)
You may also want to get an empty waterskin to complete the Enaqua achievement
Bandit Camp Teleport, Bandit Camp lodestone or Archaeology teleport for getting to the quest location

rewards.t: A camulet, which allows you to talk to camels and teleport to the temple four times; it can be recharged by using camel dung on it.
Camel mask (use a piece of soft clay on the pedestal with the globes on it to make one)

steps.t: Head to the granite and sandstone quarry southwest of the Bandit Camp lodestone.
Talk to Lazim. [Chat: Accept › 2 Okay, I'll get on with it.]
If you don't already have your sandstone, mine 52kg of sandstone in the nearby quarry.

Give Lazim 32kg of sandstone. [Chat: 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a small 2 kg block.]
Craft the sandstone (32kg) he gives you, use it on the flat ground.
Talk to Lazim. [Chat: 2 I'll do it right away!]

Give Lazim another 20 kg of sandstone. [Chat: 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block. › 1 Yes, I have more stone. › 1 Here's a medium 5 kg block.]
Craft the sandstone (20kg) he gives you, use it on the statue base.
Chisel the headless statue, speak to Lazim. [Chat: 4 I think it should have a camel's head.]
Mine or obtain two 5kg granite chunks.
Craft a 5kg chunk of granite. [Chat: 1 Carve a head for the statue. › 4 The head of a camel]
Use the stone camel head on the headless statue.

Interact with the fallen statue four times, use the "Chisel" option. [Chat: 1 Chisel › 1 Remove the statue's left arm] [Chat: 1 Chisel › 1 Remove the statue's right arm] [Chat: 1 Chisel › 1 Remove the statue's left leg] [Chat: 1 Chisel]
Take-sigil from the nearby pedestal for the letter "M".
Go north and through the door. Click to skip the cutscene.
Go all the way west and through the door to the south. Click to skip the cutscene.
Go south and take the path to east which is leading to the middle room. Unlock the door using the M sigil.

Optionally, leave the middle room and go through the remaining two outer doors, gather the remaining three sigils, and unlock the remaining three doors that lead to the middle room. The outer doors will become permanently locked post-quest if the stone limbs are destroyed as they cannot be reclaimed.
Climb up the middle room's ladder.
Use your soft clay on the pedestal for a camel mould (p).
Craft your second chunk of granite 5kg . [Chat: 1 Carve a shape to fit the pedestal.]
Use the new head on the pedestal, a cutscene starts (which can be skipped).
Talk to Lazim.
Use either bread, cake, pie, potato, or a pizza on Pentyn in the north-western room. [Chat: 4 It's okay, I don't need any help.]
Go to the west room, equip your staff or wand, melt the fountain using a fire spell.

sub.t: If you have a waterskin, you can refill it at the fountain for a Hard Desert Achievement, Enaqua.

steps.t: Go to the northeast room, clear the furnace with a staff or wand equipped using an air spell.

sub.t: Retrieve coal from the metal bank if it is not already in the backpack.

steps.t: Go to the east room, investigate each brazier, using the respective resource on each of them.

sub.t: Retrieve coal from the metal bank at the furnace in the northeast room if you did not bring it.

steps.t: Pass-through the magical barrier in the centre, climb-up the ladder.
Climb-over pile of bones south.
Climb-down the stone ladder.
Talk to the Boneguard. [Chat: 2 Of course, I'll help you out. › 4 Okay, I'll start building.]
Take-rock from the nearby rubble for a chunk of sandstone. Do this three times.
Inspect the wall to add the sandstone then inspect it again to chisel it. Repeat this twice more.
Talk to the Boneguard for the final cutscene (this can also be skipped).
Quest complete!
